findings: Witch architecture still reads as a tidy generic timber house with broad blank roof and gable surfaces.
Covered service work and ingredient access are physically improved; the long awning and oversized cauldron still dominate the composition.

Workrooms and storage need fitted groups and useful wall relationships. The actual default seed 8102 bedroom trace confirms a bed and storage exist; a sparse view alone is not evidence that the room is unfurnished.
Firebrick joints and actual backing are now visible, with supported fuel and volumetric heat cues.
Both mantel corners shimmer from coincident faces. Three straight bright flame tongues still read as cones.
The default thatched cottage workbench and vessel obscure most of the fireplace in the fixed portrait.
Broad plain roofs, excessive chimney proportions and sparse room composition remain broader domestic design work.
